01 — EDUCATION PLATFORM / IN DEVELOPMENT

DevTrack

A teacher’s workspace bringing together lessons, attendance, assessment and student projects.

Next.jsReactDrizzle ORMPostgreSQL
Explore the engineering +

The problem

Teaching data lives in separate workflows: timetables, attendance, grades and project repositories. Moving between them creates repeated manual work.

My work

Building a unified product around those workflows, combining a Next.js interface with a Laravel timetable API, PostgreSQL data and third-party integrations.

Engineering focus

Mapping external lessons to journal entries, keeping attendance tied to the right lesson, and designing permissions around teachers and students. The journal synchronisation uses a stable source key and a database upsert to update imported lessons without duplicating journal entries.

Timetable → journal synchronisation

A stable source key and a scoped upsert update imported lessons instead of creating duplicates.

services/journal.js
const sourceKey = `timetable:${lesson.date}:${lesson.id}:${lesson.period || 0}`;
await tx
  .insert(journalEntries)
  .values({
    courseId: course.id,
    source: "timetable",
    sourceKey,
    type: "lesson",
    date: lesson.date,
    startsAt: new Date(rigaDateTimeIso(lesson.date, lesson.start)),
    endsAt: new Date(rigaDateTimeIso(lesson.date, lesson.end)),
    timetableLessonId: lesson.id,
    timetablePeriod: lesson.period || null,
  })
  .onConflictDoUpdate({
    target: [journalEntries.courseId, journalEntries.sourceKey],
    set: {
      startsAt: new Date(rigaDateTimeIso(lesson.date, lesson.start)),
      endsAt: new Date(rigaDateTimeIso(lesson.date, lesson.end)),
      timetablePeriod: lesson.period || null,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    },
  });
GITHUB SOURCEOriginal · L199–221
Normalising external room names

Different room labels are normalised before looking up an active classroom.

lib/attendanceAutomation.js
export function normalizeRoomName(value) {
  return String(value || "")
    .trim()
    .toLocaleLowerCase("lv-LV")
    .replace(/^(classroom|room|telpa|kabinets)\s*/u, "")
    .replace(/^c[.\s-]*(?=\d)/u, "")
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu, "");
}

export function classroomForTimetableRoom(room, classrooms = []) {
  const key = normalizeRoomName(room);
  if (!key) return null;
  return (
    classrooms.find(
      (classroom) =>
        classroom.active !== false && normalizeRoomName(classroom.name) === key,
    ) || null
  );
}
GITHUB SOURCEOriginal · L1–19
Time boundaries + session identity

A lesson is active from its start until, but excluding, its end. Session identity also checks classroom, group and start time.

lib/attendanceAutomation.js
export function isTimetableBlockActive(block, now = new Date()) {
  const value = new Date(now).getTime();
  return (
    Number.isFinite(value) &&
    new Date(block.startsAt).getTime() <= value &&
    new Date(block.endsAt).getTime() > value
  );
}

export function sameScheduledSession(session, block, classroomId) {
  return (
    session.classroomId === classroomId &&
    session.groupId === block.groupId &&
    new Date(session.startsAt).getTime() === new Date(block.startsAt).getTime()
  );

02 — FOUNDER / FULL-STACK DEVELOPMENT

Deskplan

A classroom seating platform with QR check-in, real-time occupancy and session history.

LaravelSanctumMySQLStripe
Explore the engineering +

The model

Schools, users, classrooms, desks, lesson periods and seat sessions form the core domain. Desk coordinates let teachers arrange a classroom visually.

The workflow

A QR code identifies a desk. Check-in and check-out create the classroom’s current seating state and its history, with school admin, teacher and student roles.

Beyond CRUD

The product brings together access control, classroom state endpoints, public live and QR views, timetable integration and subscription billing through Laravel Cashier.

A compact classroom version endpoint

The client can request a version and update timestamp without receiving the full classroom state.

app/Http/Controllers/Api/ClassroomApiController.php
public function version(Classroom $classroom)
{
    abort_unless(optional($classroom->school)->active, 403);

    return response()->json([
        'version' => (int) $classroom->version,
        'updatedAt' => ($classroom->updated_at?->timestamp) ?? now()->timestamp,
    ]);
}

Inside the code 3 examples+
Sales → commission ledger

Sale and team-override entries have separate types. Conflicts on lead, user and type are ignored on repeated calls.

api/leads/index.js
async function createCommissions(q,lead,userCommissionCents){
 const ownerRows=await q`SELECT id,parent_user_id,payout_cents FROM users WHERE id=${lead.owner_id} LIMIT 1`;
 const owner=ownerRows[0];
 if(!owner)return;
 const saleAmount=userCommissionCents==null?Number(owner.payout_cents||0):Number(userCommissionCents||0);
 await q`INSERT INTO commission_ledger(lead_id,user_id,type,amount_cents,status)
   VALUES(${lead.id},${owner.id},'SALE',${saleAmount},'PENDING')
   ON CONFLICT (lead_id,user_id,type) DO NOTHING`;
 if(owner.parent_user_id){
  const parentRows=await q`SELECT id,role,override_cents,active FROM users WHERE id=${owner.parent_user_id} LIMIT 1`;
  const parent=parentRows[0];
  if(parent?.role==="team_lead"&&parent.active&&Number(parent.override_cents||0)>0){
   await q`INSERT INTO commission_ledger(lead_id,user_id,type,amount_cents,status)
     VALUES(${lead.id},${parent.id},'TEAM_OVERRIDE',${Number(parent.override_cents||0)},'PENDING')
     ON CONFLICT (lead_id,user_id,type) DO NOTHING`;
  }
 }
 return saleAmount;
}

Role-aware lead access

This helper allows admins, owners and team leads whose direct report owns the lead.

api/leads/index.js
async function canAccess(q,user,ownerId){
 if(user.role==="admin")return true;
 if(ownerId===user.id)return true;
 if(user.role==="team_lead"){
  const rows=await q`SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id=${ownerId} AND parent_user_id=${user.id} LIMIT 1`;
  return !!rows[0];
 }
 return false;
}

Follow-up rules for lost leads

Do-not-contact blocks reactivation. Other reasons use a cooldown or a validated future follow-up date.

api/leads/index.js
function lostPolicy(reason,requestedDate){
 const r=String(reason||"").trim().toUpperCase();
 if(r==="DO_NOT_CONTACT")return{reason:r,doNotContact:true,reactivateAfter:null};
 if(r==="CALL_LATER"){
  const date=String(requestedDate||"").slice(0,10);
  if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)||date<=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10))return null;
  return{reason:r,doNotContact:false,reactivateAfter:date};
 }
 const days=lostCooldownDays[r];
 if(!days)return null;
 return{reason:r,doNotContact:false,reactivateAfter:plusDays(days)};
}
function reactivationEligible(l){
 if(l.status!=="LOST"||l.do_not_contact)return false;
 if(!l.reactivate_after)return false;
 return String(l.reactivate_after).slice(0,10)<=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
}

Inside the code 3 examples+
Diacritics + typo-tolerant answers

Answers are normalised, compared for inclusion and checked with a bounded Levenshtein distance.

src/utils/matcher.ts
export function checkMatch(guess: string, target: string, normalizedTargetExtra?: string): boolean {
  const normGuess = normalizeLatvianText(guess);
  const normTarget = normalizeLatvianText(target);
  const normExtra = normalizedTargetExtra ? normalizeLatvianText(normalizedTargetExtra) : '';

  if (!normGuess || !normTarget) return false;

  // Exact or word inclusion
  if (normGuess === normTarget) return true;
  if (normExtra && normExtra.includes(normGuess)) return true;

  // If guess contains target or target contains guess (length >= 4)
  if (normGuess.length >= 4 && normTarget.includes(normGuess)) return true;
  if (normTarget.length >= 4 && normGuess.includes(normTarget)) return true;

  // Levenshtein fuzzy distance for typos
  const distance = levenshteinDistance(normGuess, normTarget);
  const maxAllowedDistance = Math.min(3, Math.floor(normTarget.length / 3));

  return distance <= maxAllowedDistance;
}
GITHUB SOURCEOriginal · L56–76
Making Latvian answers comparable

Latvian diacritics, punctuation and repeated spaces are normalised before comparing player answers.

src/utils/matcher.ts
export function normalizeLatvianText(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[āáàâä]/g, 'a')
    .replace(/[čç]/g, 'c')
    .replace(/[ēéèêë]/g, 'e')
    .replace(/[ģğ]/g, 'g')
    .replace(/[īíìîï]/g, 'i')
    .replace(/[ķ]/g, 'k')
    .replace(/[ļ]/g, 'l')
    .replace(/[ņ]/g, 'n')
    .replace(/[šś]/g, 's')
    .replace(/[ūúùûü]/g, 'u')
    .replace(/[žźż]/g, 'z')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

// SSE Clients for real-time synchronization
const sseClients: express.Response[] = [];

function broadcastState() {
  const data = `data: ${JSON.stringify(gameState)}\n\n`;
  sseClients.forEach((res) => {
    try {
      res.write(data);
    } catch {
      // Ignore disconnected
    }
  });
}

Inside the code 3 examples+
Programme interval validation

Strict interval comparisons reject overlapping programmes while allowing adjacent programmes to share a boundary.

app/Services/GuideService.php
public function ensureNoOverlap(int $channelNr, Carbon $startsAt, Carbon $endsAt): void
{
    $overlapExists = Guide::query()
        ->where('channel_nr', $channelNr)
        ->where(function ($query) use ($startsAt, $endsAt) {
            $query->where('starts_at', '<', $endsAt)
                ->where('ends_at', '>', $startsAt);
        })
        ->exists();

    if ($overlapExists) {
        throw ValidationException::withMessages([
            'starts_at' => 'Programmas ieraksts pārklājas ar esošu ierakstu.',
        ]);
    }
}
GITHUB SOURCEOriginal · L98–113
A broadcast day starts at 06:00

The service builds a 24-hour interval from 06:00 on the selected date to 06:00 the following day.

app/Services/GuideService.php
public function tvDayBounds(string $date): array
{
    $from = Carbon::parse($date . ' 06:00:00');
    $to = (clone $from)->addDay();

    return [$from, $to];
}
GITHUB SOURCEOriginal · L115–121
Programme ends derived from the next start

The display end time uses the next programme start, falling back to the original end time when there is no next programme.

app/Services/GuideService.php
public function withAdjustedEndTimes(Collection $guides, int $channelNr): Collection
{
    $guides = $guides->values();

    foreach ($guides as $index => $guide) {
        $nextGuide = $guides->get($index + 1)
            ?? Guide::query()
                ->where('channel_nr', $channelNr)
                ->where('starts_at', '>', $guide->starts_at)
                ->orderBy('starts_at')
                ->first();

        $guide->setAttribute(
            'adjusted_ends_at',
            $nextGuide ? $nextGuide->starts_at : $guide->ends_at
        );
    }

    return $guides;
}
